requirement: Build a clean-room reservation service that prevents double-booking and duplicate side effects under concurrency, retries, equivalent time representations, and invalid input.
acceptance: Overlapping reservations for the same resource cannot both commit.
A retry with the same idempotency key does not create a second side effect.
The same instant represented with different timezone offsets is treated consistently.
Invalid time intervals are rejected without creating state.
The implementation can be started from the documented clean-container contract.
constraints: Treat the requirement as workload input, not an agent mandate.
Do not encode Tablekeeper-specific language into generic agent mandates.
Every stage must hand off an inspectable artifact.
Verification must be reproducible from the repository.
